messages.subject: CMC done - directions and disclosure deadline
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

HHJ Ashcombe gave directions at the CMC today: Model C extended disclosure by exchange of lists on 14 November, witness statements by 16 January, expert reports exchanged 27 February, joint statement 27 March, and a 5-day trial window from 1 June 2026. Our costs budget approved at £486k, theirs at £441k. She also nudged the parties towards ADR by end January.

Our disclosure list is essentially ready. Draft order to follow.

Elena

Elena Marchetti
Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
